mapper.sql: id, source_id, status, added, updated, skipped, failed, error_detail, started_at, finished_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO ingest_run ( source_id, status, reason, trigger_type, attempt, worker_id, lease_token, claimed_at, heartbeat_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, 'RUNNING', #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'MANUAL', 0, #{workerId}, CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid), now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (source_id) WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'DEFERRED') DO NOTHING RETURNING

INSERT INTO ingest_run ( source_id, status, reason, trigger_type, attempt, scheduled_at, worker_id, lease_token, claimed_at, heartbeat_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, 'RUNNING', #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{triggerType}, 0, #{scheduledAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{workerId}, CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid), now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (source_id) WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'DEFERRED') DO NOTHING RETURNING
SELECT id, source_id, reason, attempt, trigger_type FROM ingest_run WHERE id = #{runId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO ingest_run ( source_id, status, reason, trigger_type, attempt, worker_id, lease_token, claimed_at, heartbeat_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, 'RUNNING', #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'RETRY', #{attempt}, #{workerId}, CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid), now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (source_id) WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'DEFERRED') DO NOTHING RETURNING

INSERT INTO ingest_run ( source_id, status, reason, trigger_type, attempt, worker_id, lease_token, claimed_at, heartbeat_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, 'RUNNING', #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'IMPORT', #{attempt}, #{workerId}, CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid), now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (source_id) WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'DEFERRED') DO NOTHING RETURNING
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingest_run_item ( run_id, item_key, item_kind, status, document_id, retry_count, next_attempt_at, checkpoint, checkpoint_attempt ) SELECT #{newRunId}, item_key, item_kind, 'QUEUED', document_id, retry_count + 1, NULL, checkpoint, 0 FROM ingest_run_item WHERE run_id = #{failedRunId} AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.update: UPDATE ingest_run SET heartbeat_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: UPDATE ingest_run SET status = 'DEFERRED', worker_id = NULL, lease_token = NULL, error_code = 'HTTP_429', error_detail = 'Remote source requested a deferred retry', heartbeat_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE ingest_run SET status = 'DEFERRED', worker_id = NULL, lease_token = NULL, error_code = 'HTTP_429', error_detail = 'Remote source requested a deferred retry', heartbeat_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt = #{attempt} AND lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT run.id, run.source_id FROM ingest_run run WHERE run.status = 'DEFERRED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ingest_run_item item WHERE item.run_id = run.id AND item.status = 'FAILED' AND item.next_attempt_at <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} ) ORDER BY run.heartbeat_at ASC, run.id ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{batchSize}

UPDATE ingest_run SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt = attempt + 1, worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid), claimed_at = #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, heartbeat_at = #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, error_code = NULL, error_detail = NULL WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'DEFERRED' RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE ingest_run_item SET status = 'QUEUED', next_attempt_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'FAILED' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
mapper.select: UPDATE ingest_run SET status = #{status}, added = #{added}, updated = #{updated}, skipped = #{skipped}, failed = #{failed}, error_detail = #{errorDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, finished_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE ingest_run SET status = #{status}, added = #{added}, updated = #{updated}, skipped = #{skipped}, failed = #{failed}, error_code = #{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_detail = #{errorDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, finished_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt = #{attempt} AND lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid)
mapper.select: UPDATE ingest_run SET status = 'FAILED', worker_id = NULL, lease_token = NULL, finished_at = now(), error_code = 'LEASE_EXPIRED', error_detail = 'lease expired' WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at < now() - CAST(#{timeout,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS interval) RETURNING

UPDATE ingest_run SET status = 'FAILED', worker_id = NULL, lease_token = NULL, finished_at = now(), error_code = 'LEASE_EXPIRED', error_detail = 'lease expired' WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND heartbeat_at < now() - CAST(#{timeout,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS interval) RETURNING
SELECT id FROM ingest_run WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt = #{attempt} AND lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) FOR UPDATE
